summary: WF-03 Step 1 (diagnosis-as-design) for GH-802/ISS-0711. CONFIRMED the documented diagnosis against the ACTUAL test file and REPRODUCED it: tests/integration/prm-08-rollback-sandbox.test.zig insertPromotionReviewsRow (lines 233-258) INSERTs only (id, tenant_id, status, def_id, plan_digest, created_at), omitting the NOT NULL requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan from migration 096; BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test zig build test-integration-prm08 failed TC-PRM-08-03 with sqlstate 23502 at line 240 called from line 466 (single call site, in TC-PRM-08-03 — the AC4 superseded_review_id path; the ISS body's 'TC-PRM-08-04' citation was corrected to TC-PRM-08-03). Defined the exact Step 3 fix spec mirroring GH-793 Cluster A (add requested_by param; include requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan in the INSERT; call site passes a fresh randomUuidStr). The reproduction trace ALSO surfaced two additional latent defects that block the GH-802 verification command, both filed per No-Issue-Left-Local-Only: (1) ISS-0712/GH-803 — production src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 supersede UPDATE compares def_id = $3::uuid against TEXT promotion_reviews.def_id -> sqlstate 42883 (operator does not exist: text = uuid), swallowed by `catch null` so superseded_review_id is always null; (2) ISS-0713/GH-804 — TC-PRM-08-03 seeds its promotion_reviews row under the random tenant UUID + zero def_id, which can never match the supersede WHERE (tenant_id=DEFAULT_TENANT_ID, def_id=current_active_id), so the 'superseded' assertion fails after the 23502/42883 fixes. No fix implemented (Step 3 only).

issues_found.description: ISS-0711/GH-802 CONFIRMED: prm-08 insertPromotionReviewsRow omits NOT NULL requested_by/def_type/serialised_plan (migration 096) -> sqlstate 23502. This is the run's scoped defect; fix spec delivered for Step 3 (mirror GH-793 Cluster A).

NEW (filed ISS-0712/GH-803): production src/definition/rollback.zig Step 5 supersede UPDATE `def_id = $3::uuid` vs TEXT promotion_reviews.def_id -> sqlstate 42883 (operator does not exist: text = uuid), swallowed by catch null -> superseded_review_id always null; PRM-08 AC4 never works. Fix: drop ::uuid cast (`def_id = $3`); distinguish missing-table 42P01 from real errors. BLOCKS GH-802 verification command; production code so it cannot be folded into GH-802.

NEW (filed ISS-0713/GH-804): TC-PRM-08-03 seeds the promotion_reviews fixture row under the random tenant UUID + zero def_id (helper hardcoded), but the supersede WHERE matches tenant_id=DEFAULT_TENANT_ID AND def_id=current_active_id (V2), so the row can never be superseded and the 'superseded' assertion fails after the 23502/42883 fixes. Fix (test-only): seed with tenant_id=DEFAULT_TENANT_ID and def_id=def_id_v2. May be folded into GH-802 Step 3 or run separately (ORCH decision).
